purpose: Restore the original XGTC full-initialization reset intervals found with REA/Ghidra, without changing loss-sync recovery or business commit timeouts.

tooling.mode: Local static analysis; existing isolated installation, no global configuration changes or remote artifact upload

original.note: REA loaded analysis addresses are not physical MMIO addresses or ELF section offsets.

defect: The native full-initialization sequence used three1ms waits where this board original aal_xgpon_init calls ca_mdelay(100) after reset assertion, reset release and final mode selection. The separate original warm-reset routine has1ms waits but is a different sequence.
fix: Change only the three full-init waits to msleep(100), retaining the original register values and order. Do not increase polling timeouts, add retries, change identity, or introduce a vendor ABI.

verification.scope: Actual original aal_xgpon_init instructions and native prepare function. Original child initializers, native stop and indirect table completion are modeled. Compare reset ordering and requested waits, not elapsed silicon timing or optical operation.

limits: This restores the board original timing contract; the minimum silicon settling time was not measured.
No evidence yet ties the original1ms waits to the peer reported -110 or50-second ACTP cycle.
Only targeted instruction/model replay and one ARM64 object build; no full tests, kernel link or firmware build.
No device connection, deployment, commit or push in this change.
